# Quant Lab — Brief

**Status:** Accepted · **Last updated:** 2026-10-15

## Problem
I want to learn quantitative research by building it, and find out whether any signal survives honest testing.

## Users
Me, the only user: a solo developer learning quant research.

## Goals
1. A reliable daily US equity dataset, free of survivorship and look-ahead bias.
2. Honest estimates of return structure and risk.
3. Portfolios that hold up out of sample against simple baselines.

## Constraints
- Python on a laptop; data under $50/month.

## Not doing
- Intraday data, options, crypto, real money.
